scope: Bernalillo County Technical Standards archival review

candidate.title: Complete Bernalillo County Technical Standards
candidate.size_reason: A comprehensive 226-page technical standard containing road, drainage, traffic-review, construction, and green-infrastructure requirements, figures, tables, and appendices.

smaller_authoritative_version.notes: The smaller April-hosted copy is a distinct, two-page-shorter file. The landing page separately labels the May-hosted file as the complete standards, so it is the preservation candidate.

candidate.optimization_notes: No derivative is proposed. Preserve the complete authoritative PDF unchanged because fidelity and completeness matter.
candidate.content_review: The document governs County development review and transportation/drainage infrastructure, including street networks, roadway geometry, intersections, pedestrian and bicycle facilities, traffic calming, pavement, traffic impact analysis, construction, and green stormwater infrastructure.
candidate.visual_review: Title, contents, transportation-network, and traffic-review pages rendered successfully and were visually intact.

remaining_queue_storage.complete_project_estimate: At least 1,941,387,173 bytes if every currently known-size unarchived candidate qualified and remained unique. A defensible final total is not yet possible because 3,011 nonterminal records have no file size and many are web pages or will be excluded rather than archived.

decision: Preserve the complete May-hosted authoritative edition unchanged in R2, use the dated archive link on ABQInfo, and retain both the current County standards page and official County PDF links for source-of-truth and update checks.
